definition: Unique block key; joins signal observations and measurement index. Required.
Original workbook and worksheet names. Required; not a donor identifier.
Original worksheet row; preserves observation provenance.
Location of the extracted block in the source worksheet.
Elapsed block time. Finite observations retained; ordering/duplicates checked.
Measured shear stress. Required for extraction; missing stress is never zero-filled.
Measured strain, when supplied. Missing if absent or unusable.
Measured rate, when supplied; missing channel remains missing.
LAOS or STEP_UP_DOWN; subtypes LAOS, STEP_UP, STEP_DOWN, STEP_UNKNOWN.
Original test label, retained even when it conflicts with a measured channel.
Parsed amplitude; percent = 100 times fraction. Missing when not identified.
Nominal angular frequency. A valid frequency and amplitude are required for the LAOS cohort.
Aligned observation count and last-minus-first timestamp.
Inverse median positive time interval; a summary, not evidence of uniform sampling.
Quality-control information or review status. Flags do not automatically remove a record.
First matching trace ID; blank when no exact duplicate was identified.
Block key and workbook labels. In ARM-STEP, step_id uses the shared measurement ID; sample is not a verified donor ID.
Storage condition parsed from sheet label; zero is also the parser default when no tag is present.
Initial/final analysis rates after measured-channel checks; labels supply missing rates.
Rate-label agreement status. Mismatch records remain descriptive but are excluded from inference.
End of operational instrument exclusion; minimum 0.05 s.
Observations in the two analysis windows. At least three are required for window descriptors.
Median late-window reference stress. Missing when no late observations exist; does not itself certify stability.
Fitted late-window drift and its magnitude divided by max(abs(reference), 0.001 Pa).
True when finite drift satisfies the relative or absolute tolerance in Appendix B.
Join keys in the dataset manifest and separate reference-label table.
Observed simulator channels. Exact column names and units are supplied in the synthetic feature dictionary.
Reference labels stored separately from detector inputs; the event is q = 0.5.
